C9000169.statement: Adversarially audit, verify, or refute OpenAI Manuscript Family 169 (Shareshian–Wachs elementary positivity.; papers: Elementary positivity of chromatic quasisymmetric functions; Lean status: Partially/Comparator formalized (lean/docs/169.md)): either (a) discover and certify an explicit mathematical flaw, sign/orientation error, counterexample to an intermediate lemma, or statement-fidelity/citation gap with a deterministic symbolic/computational certificate (`verify.py` + `exact_certificate.json`), or (b) independently verify, repair, or generalize the manuscript's core mathematical theorem with a standalone machine-checkable certificate certified by the independent Reviewer.

V_ALG_COPRODUCT.statement: For every same-slope split d=a+b under the literal hypotheses of Lemma alg:coproduct, the Laurent coefficient C_0 defines an unlocalized map gr B_d -> gr B_a tensor gr B_b preserving total filtration weight and original shifted degree, and every pair of independent refinement symbols equals the concatenated source symbol.

L_RESTRICTIONS.statement: Same-slope separated-center restrictions descend through destabilizing ideals, compose under refinement, and have homogeneous target ideals (alg:restrictions).

L_DETECTION.statement: Normalized leading restriction symbols are polynomial and jointly injective; their tensor products characterize the additive tensor filtration and detect every associated tensor grade (alg:detection).

K_POLYNOMIAL_IMAGE_DESCENT.statement: Let T:V -> W be an injective rational linear map and c:Z -> V. If T(c_j) is the integer-indexed coefficient family of a W-valued polynomial q, then all negative c_j vanish and the nonnegative c_j form a V-valued polynomial mapping to q, with constant coefficient c_0.

D_COPRODUCT_FIXTURE.statement: For the supplied three-occurrence fixture, B_(1,1,1)=Q[z,t,h]/(h^2,ht), h is nonzero, its only filtration grades are Q[z] in weight 0 and tQ[z,t] direct_sum hQ[z] in weight 1, and Delta_ab(tH+hG)=-H(v,u-v), Delta_ba(tH+hG)=H(u,v-u), while both proper components vanish on weight 0; these formulas hold for every polynomial H,G.

L_PRODUCT_SYMBOLS.statement: The same-slope shuffle product is filtered and its leading symbols obey alg:product-symbol-formula.

L_ORDERED.statement: Ordered multiplication gives the decreasing-slope vector-space decomposition alg:ordered.

M_BIALGEBRA.statement: The auxiliary associated grade is a connected dimension-graded signed cocommutative bialgebra (alg:bialgebra).

M_PBW.statement: Signed symmetrized multiplication identifies the signed symmetric vector space on the primitives with the associated-graded bialgebra (alg:pbw).

M_STRINGS.statement: The primitive space decomposes into polynomial-degree strings with the asserted dimension-dependent sign (alg:strings).

M_REORDERING.statement: Admissible elementary-unit products positively reorder with admissible nonnegative integral output multiplicities and effective finite coefficient calculations (alg:reordering).

M_WALL_POSITIVITY.statement: The wall recursion has nonnegative jump coefficients and propagates incoming positivity to all chambers (wall:factors, wall:recursion, wall:positivity).

M_TRI_MONOMIAL.statement: Uniformly in triangular charts, m_lambda(Y)=Theta_(sum_i lambda_i d_i), including the elementary special case (tri:monomial).

M_GRAPH_KERNEL.statement: The graph kernel expresses elementary coefficients through torus coefficients of m_lambda(Y), with the stated reciprocity (graph:kernel, graph:reciprocity).

M_E_POSITIVITY.statement: All elementary coefficients of every natural unit interval graph's chromatic quasisymmetric function lie in N[q] (tri:positivity).

M_PERM_WITNESS.statement: The finite packet, parity, and exact-mask rules assign each admissible permutation an elementary partition with the required graph-inversion fibers (route:witness).

M_TRI_INCOMING_CONTROL.statement: The triangular-chart stationary-label, pure-extraction, and linear incoming-expansion assertions hold with their stated scopes (tri:stationary, tri:pure, tri:linear).

M_TRI_DOMINATION.statement: The theta-section domination bound by U^N implies finite Laurent support and nonnegative vertex exponents (tri:domination).

M_PACKET_EXACT_MASK.statement: Finite coefficient slices, positive packet switches, return paths, parity control, and exact-mask refinement supply the claimed individual permutation algorithm (route:finite, route:switch, route:return, route:parity, route:exact).

M_MAIN.statement: A deterministic terminating individual permutation map gives the manuscript's uniform elementary-positive witness identity (main:theorem, main:completion).
